content:
Since iOS 26.4, Apple has begun to support conversational apps on CarPlay.

This category covers AI chatbot apps. Siri AI will join CarPlay starting with iOS 27. The iPhone system update is currently in Beta testing and will be officially released in September.

At the same time, a fourth third-party AI chatbot has begun supporting Apple CarPlay: Meta AI.

The Meta AI iPhone app now supports Apple CarPlay — but with one limitation.

The latest version of the iPhone Meta AI app now works on CarPlay.

The Meta AI app joins the ranks of three other third-party chatbot apps available on CarPlay: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Grok.

However, Meta AI on CarPlay appears to still be in a limited testing phase at present.

Although the iPhone app will appear in CarPlay, launching the app currently may display a "not supported" message.

In my testing, launching the CarPlay app shows the message "Your account does not currently support the Meta AI experience."

I tried using a paid Meta AI account to see whether the CarPlay feature requires a paid account. However, the message in the Meta AI CarPlay app did not change. Your experience may vary.

In any case, it's great to see CarPlay welcome a fourth mainstream chatbot app before Siri AI officially rolls out to everyone.

This is CarPlay's greatest strength: integrating your existing iPhone apps with your car. This level of rich choice is unmatched by built-in infotainment systems.

Earlier this month, Meta AI also landed on Mac. The desktop version is significantly more powerful than the iPhone and iPad versions.
